remarks: Enjoy this one of a kind high end home. Pristine condition from top to bottom. Deck with a hot tub, and great for year round entertaining. 5 bedrooms and in law suite or den. Large finished lower level for playroom and/or gym, and a full bath. 2 car garage and mudroom. Open kitchen and living room with fireplace, also with wet bar. Primary suite with walk-in-closet, whirlpool tub, dual sinks. 3 more bedrooms on the second floor, as well as laundry for convenience. Third floor has multipurpose room for office or 5th bedroom with full bath.
